LanguageData.RandomStartMod.Misc.RandomXenotypeChance: Sets the chance for each starting colonist to receive a randomized xenotype or custom gene set. When sharing one xenotype, the chance is rolled once for the whole group.
LanguageData.RandomStartMod.Scenarios.AlwaysSpawnEsse: Always add two stacks of 25 vegetables, 1-2 weapons appropriate to your faction's tech level, and 5 medicine. Tribal and medieval factions receive herbal medicine and 25 pemmican per colonist; industrial and higher-tech factions receive industrial medicine and 5 packaged survival meals per colonist.
